evidence_scope: Complete exploratory shared-service development comparisons; not held-out evidence
interpretation_limits: Same configured experiment except model ID; backend versions, model/tokenizer behavior and unexposed server defaults are not controlled.
Cases are known synthetic/AI-assisted development inputs; wording reuses 24 controlled bases.
Accepted means a gold-valid feasible schedule or correct UNSAT answer, not necessarily an optimal schedule.
Provider failures remain in denominators. Missing usage is unknown, not zero.
Qwen3.8 has two recorded safe same-process pauses; elapsed clocks and operational delays are not pure inference time.
Within-model paired intervals use existing family bootstrap; ceiling/degenerate intervals do not prove equivalence or population perfection.
Automated audit and replay do not establish course model eligibility, human review or submission.

extraction.caution: Structural differences do not alone establish semantic errors.

validation.scope: Completed shared-service development benchmark; not held-out/fixed-backend evidence
